pages.title: Screen
pages.text: This is an ordinary display screen. Right-click it to open its GUI, where you can select the displayed content and adjust rotation around the X, Y, and Z axes as well as pixel offsets along those axes. This lets the screen fit a convenient viewing angle and position.$(br2)The available modes are Radar and Information. Radar shows the Control Seat's scan results. Information shows server and client memory use together with the current physics tick rate, providing advance warning of a possible physics thread crash.

pages.title: Fun Facts
pages.text: 1. The screen model can be rotated and translated freely, but its interaction area remains at the block itself. Making an interaction area follow a moving model in real time is not simple.$(br2)2. The physics TPS display was originally intended for Valkyrien Skies, whose physics thread crashed far too easily.
